content: We need to finish the customer export writer. The downstream loader accepts UTF-16LE only, and every file must begin with a byte-order mark. Never write exports to the shared NFS mount.

I traced the existing path through src/export_writer.py and tests/test_export_writer.py. I rejected a Kafka-based pipeline: this is a one-shot export, so Kafka adds operations work without solving a requirement.
Keep the batch size at exactly 500 rows. The acceptance fixture contains 12,418 rows, so the final batch must contain 418.
The row serializer and 500-row batching tests now pass. I also confirmed that port 9443 belongs to the metrics sidecar, not this exporter.
Stop before changing deployment configuration. Hand this work to Agent B with the constraints and rejected approach intact.

Current state: the writer still needs UTF-16LE output plus the byte-order mark. Next, implement that in src/export_writer.py, add the 12,418-row acceptance test, and do not change deployment configuration or use the shared NFS mount.
